title: filesystem_write input
description: Modify files and folders. Every operation requires user confirmation.

action.description: What to do. write=create/overwrite, append=add to end, delete=remove file, move=rename/move, mkdir=create folder, rmdir=remove empty folder.

path.description: Absolute path to a file (write/append/delete/move source) or folder (mkdir/rmdir). Use ~/Desktop, ~/Documents, %USERPROFILE%\Desktop.

content.description: Text to write or append. Required for write/append. Max 50 MB.

destination.description: Target path for move. Required for move. Must be on the same volume as path.
